messages:
sam-sales: Hey team — trying to close FoxPoint POC. They want final Order Form + MSA/DPA redlines resolved before PO. Can legal confirm which redlines are blockers? Also finance is asking about billing cadence (Net30 vs Net45) and whether we can show KMS/HSM support for Private deployment.

olivia-legal: Hi Sam — I skimmed the redlines. Two big items: 1) Limitation of liability cap (they want 3x fees) — we should push back to standard cap (1x fees). 2) Data residency/addendum in DPA — acceptable but need to scope subprocessor list. If they insist on broader liability we'll need Exec approval. For signatures: who is the counterparty signer?

ben-ps: On pricing, the POC used Dedicated capacity for burst. If they convert to Dedicated commit, the unit cost changes. I updated quote_v3 (link: https://redwood.example/quote/FP-2345) showing Net30 and Net45 columns. Net30 gives smaller finance discount.

maya-cs: Also they asked for SOC 2 Type II report and SAML SSO timeline — we can provide SOC2 report within an NDA; SAML integration for their IdP will take ~2 weeks for the POC team.

ciara-ops: KMS: For Private we support customer-managed KMS via our Vault/HSM integration. We can provide a KMS attestation doc and a short config checklist. They asked for key rotation policy — we have a standard template.

sam-sales: Olivia — can Legal propose concrete language for the liability cap and a DPA addendum that limits subprocessors? If Exec sign-off is needed, we need to know before Friday.

olivia-legal: Yes. Proposed edits: replace their cap with "the greater of $250,000 or fees paid in prior 12 months"; keep confidentiality and indemnities as-is. For subprocessors, add Appendix A with an updatable list and 30 days notice. If they push 3x cap, we'll need VP Legal/GC sign-off — ETA 48h if needed.

sam-sales: Great. On signature routing, they want two signers: Procurement (PO issuance) and Finance (invoice/ach). Who in their org should we send DocuSign to first?

ben-ps: Ask for Procurement first, then CFO. We should create envelope with signing order: procurement -> legal counterparty -> redwood sales -> redwood finance. Example routing snippet: 
```
{
  "routing": ["procurement@foxpoint.com", "legal@foxpoint.com", "sam-sales@redwood.com", "finance@redwood.com"]
}
```

olivia-legal: That ordering is fine. Also request a countersignature clause for manual wet-ink if their ERP requires it.

ciara-ops: I'll assemble KMS attestation + rotation policy + short runbook and post to the thread by EOD.

contract-bot: Reminder: Order Form v3 must include PO number field if customer will send PO. Set field: PO_NUMBER_REQUIRED = true.

sam-sales: Thanks. Next steps for me: 1) Send redline proposals from Legal to FoxPoint; 2) Share quote_v3 with Net30/Net45 options; 3) Create DocuSign envelope using the routing above and set PO field optional/required based on their answer. Will update here when sent. :thumbsup:

olivia-legal: I'll upload the redlines and annotated rationale in a private share (NDA) and ping once ready.

maya-cs: I'll DM the SOC2 request flow to their security contact and start the SAML scheduling.

ben-ps: If they pick Dedicated commit, we'll need a 60-day notice for capacity provisioning — flagging for their procurement team.

sam-sales: Perfect. If anyone sees any hidden blockers (payments/treasury, export control), call them out now. Otherwise I'll start outreach.

olivia-legal: No other blockers from Legal so far. :white_check_mark:
